description: The additional-tensor oversize warning references the preceding module variable instead of the current tensor key.
trigger: An additional tensor reports n_bytes greater than max_shard_bytes.
expected_behavior: Identify the oversized additional tensor and continue allocating its shard.
actual_behavior: With ordinary modules present, the warning identifies the last module instead. If model.modules is empty, evaluating module.key raises UnboundLocalError before allocation continues.

verification.description: Inspected the new extra-tensor loop and the preceding module loop. Whole-parent literal caller search found conversion main calling compile_model after its conversion loop. The supplied default hook returns no additional tensors, so this observation concerns nonempty hook implementations rather than demonstrated failures of current text conversions.
verification.limits: No repository execution; literal search does not establish external or dynamic caller coverage.
